# Arguments: zin_arg_act (keyword white_peace 1, access_both 2, join_or_access 3, send_arms 4, access_to_aenor 5).
zin_aenor_event_diplomacy = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_act = 1 } }
		AEN = { white_peace = { tag = ROOT } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_act = 2 } }
		give_military_access = AEN
		AEN = { give_military_access = ROOT }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_act = 3 } }
		if = {
			limit = { AEN = { is_faction_leader = yes } }
			AEN = { add_to_faction = ROOT }
		}
		else = {
			give_military_access = AEN
			AEN = { give_military_access = ROOT }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_act = 4 } }
		AEN = { send_equipment = { equipment = zin_arms_equipment amount = 2000 target = ROOT } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_act = 5 } }
		give_military_access = AEN
	}
}
